message: role="none"> with a way to land on it, which overrides it
$reason: `presentational-wrapper-with-aria` with a stop for the attribute: ARIA's conflict resolution drops a presentational role from an element a user can land on as well, so the wrapper owns the option, and axe reports `aria-required-children` (measured, axe 4.13). A reading that let only a global attribute override the role passed it.
